tools.name: kanbai_list_templates
tools.description: List Kanbai's public project templates (name, description, task count). Templates are the reusable task graphs new projects are instantiated from — public reference content, not a customer's live project data.

tools.name: kanbai_get_template
tools.description: Get one public project template by numeric id, including its ordered task list (title, description, status/priority defaults, offset and duration in days).

tools.name: kanbai_list_sops
tools.description: List Kanbai's public standard operating procedures (title, category).

tools.name: kanbai_get_sop
tools.description: Get one public SOP by numeric id, including its full content.
